recognize_zh: 淋巴組織 H&E 高倍下可見多量大型免疫母細胞（immunoblasts），核仁明顯，並有一個雙核、類似 Reed-Sternberg 的細胞，背景混合小淋巴球、漿細胞與凋亡小體，呈多形性反應，符合傳染性單核球增多症。
features: Polymorphous lymphoid infiltrate of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid cells, and many large immunoblasts
Immunoblasts with vesicular nuclei, distinct nucleoli, and moderate amphophilic cytoplasm
Occasional binucleate or multinucleate Reed-Sternberg-like cells
Scattered apoptotic bodies and hyperchromatic pyknotic nuclei
Loss of normal architecture not assessable at this high magnification
describe_en: Sections of lymphoid tissue show a polymorphous infiltrate composed of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid cells, and numerous large immunoblasts with vesicular chromatin, prominent nucleoli, and amphophilic cytoplasm. Binucleate and multinucleate Reed-Sternberg-like cells are present, along with scattered apoptotic bodies. The cellular spectrum is continuous from small to large cells rather than a monotonous population. In the appropriate clinical setting, findings are consistent with infectious mononucleosis (EBV lymphadenitis/tonsillitis); correlation with EBV serology and EBER in situ hybridization is recommended.

ddx.vs: HRS cells in cHL are CD30+/CD15+ with weak PAX5 and CD45-/CD20-, whereas IM immunoblasts are CD20+/CD45+ and usually CD15- within a continuous spectrum of activated cells.
DLBCL shows sheets of monotonous large cells effacing architecture, whereas IM shows a polymorphous mixture with preserved sinuses/follicles and polyclonal plasma cells.
ALCL has hallmark cells with horseshoe nuclei and strong uniform CD30 with T-cell markers, unlike the B-immunoblast rich polymorphous IM infiltrate.
